# Design point P007

## Description

An application layer over unmodified Git repositories could manage service operations by quiescing planned-maintenance servers for new reads while existing reads drain. Clients would perform incremental repacks by selecting only a bounded set of small packfiles, limiting each maintenance operation’s scope.
